caseNameFull: Bazemore v. Friday and United States v. Friday

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 978.] Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument granted, and the Solicitor General is allotted 12 minutes for oral argument and petitioners Bazemore et al. are allotted 18 minutes for oral argument.
